properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (measured, 0.92.0): loop_status's awaiting_word lists only BUILT work whose record is open (delivered proposed requirements, landed ideas) and is always empty unscoped; a proposed decision counts as owed only with an approver edge, which a designer's add_decision does not draw; so five decisions put to the owner read as "Nothing is assigned" and clean: true
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause), 2026-10-26, flo2 trial on a sample apartment building design (reflow2 0.92.0).

① OBSERVED: "loop_status awaiting_word was empty despite 5 new proposed decisions awaiting the owner." NOT affected: the decisions themselves are stored proposed and readable.

② PRECEDENT: reflow2:ver:owed-to-a-contributor ("An open decision is owed only once somebody has been asked to settle it") and reflow2:chg:built-work-reads-as-built-and-the-ship-step-closes-the-idea-2026-10-13 (awaiting_word's purpose: built work whose record is open). By design, not a regression.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) awaiting_word is defined as built-but-unclosed work, so new proposals are outside it; (b) the call was unscoped, and unscoped awaiting_word is always []; (c) the decisions lack the approver mark that makes a proposed decision owed; (d) OUTSIDE reflow2: flo2's door dropped the list; (e) the observation is wrong.

④–⑤ MEASURED, read-only, loop_status {contributor_id: who:ajs, budget_chars 8000} on the trial design: awaiting_word = 1 item (a delivered proposed requirement), assigned_decisions = [], unsettled_assigned_decisions 0, next[0] "Nothing is assigned to who:ajs.", clean: true. So (a) and (c) hold; (d) refuted (the list arrives whole); (b) holds if the trial called it unscoped (not known), and either way the five decisions are in no list. Source: awaiting.rs (two families), report.rs ~1124 (approver edge discriminates), ~1392 (scoped only).

⑥ CLASS: a field named for the owner's whole queue that holds one slice of it, beside a `clean` that says nothing is owed. A designer who proposes decisions for the owner has no reflow2 call that puts them in the owner's queue without forging the owner's signature (add_decision does not draw an approver on a proposed status).

RECOMMENDED, by correctness: (1) a way to ADDRESS a proposed decision to a person ("asked of who:X", not signed by them), read by loop_status's scoped answer as a third awaiting family; (2) rename or describe awaiting_word as "built work awaiting closure" in the reply and say in `next` how many proposed decisions are unaddressed; (3) unscoped loop_status counts proposed decisions created since the export. 

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether the trial's call was scoped; whether flo2 lets a designer agent on the owner's own account draw an approver edge naming the owner. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
